# Blaze-N-Monkey's

> Mobile food truck and catering business based in Grants Pass, Oregon.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://sitescovered.com/blaze-n-monkeys/): Business overview and primary contact.
- [Our Story](https://sitescovered.com/blaze-n-monkeys/about/): Owners, history, and Grants Pass roots.
- [Menu](https://sitescovered.com/blaze-n-monkeys/menu/): Rotating-menu guidance and current-menu contact.
- [Catering](https://sitescovered.com/blaze-n-monkeys/catering/): Food truck event inquiry information.
- [Community](https://sitescovered.com/blaze-n-monkeys/community/): Food drives, partnerships, and local events.
- [Contact](https://sitescovered.com/blaze-n-monkeys/contact/): Phone and current-location guidance.

Current menus, prices, locations, and serving times should be confirmed directly with the business at (541) 441-5104.
